sloka: रामस्तु व्यथितं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रं रणाजिरे।व्यादिदेश हरिश्रेष्ठान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्ततः ।। ६.७६.५८ ।।
transliteration: rāmastu vyathitaṁ śrutvā vāliputraṁ raṇājire।vyādideśa hariśreṣṭhān jāmbavatpramukhāṁstataḥ ।। 6.76.58 ।।

translations.english: On hearing that Angada was tormented in the battlefield and pained he ordered Jambavan and the best of monkey leaders to help him.
